selection_attempted.name: visual_grounding
selection_attempted.headline: Tells the model to read the answer off the picture first and to fall back on general knowledge only after that.

selection_attempted.name: chart_read_then_answer
selection_attempted.headline: Asks the model to write down the exact numbers and labels it sees in the chart before it answers, so it is forced to look carefully instead of guessing from memory.

selection_attempted.name: explicit_arithmetic_chain
selection_attempted.headline: Asks the model to show every step of its math — writing the values it read, the formula, and each calculation — before giving the final answer.

selection_attempted.name: yes_no_counterweight
selection_attempted.headline: Reminds the model to seriously consider 'No' as the correct answer on yes/no questions rather than automatically defaulting to 'Yes'.

selection_attempted.name: conditional_arithmetic_gate
selection_attempted.headline: Tells the model to write out chart values and show its calculation only when the question actually requires math, and to answer directly when the question just asks for a name or a single label.

selection_attempted.name: verify_after_first_answer
selection_attempted.headline: Asks the model to write an initial answer and then look at the chart a second time to check whether a different bar, line, segment, or label might actually fit the question better before it commits.

selection_attempted.name: upscale_cov
selection_attempted.headline: Shows the model a higher-resolution chart, then automatically generates targeted questions to verify whether the answer it gave actually matches what is drawn in the image.

selection_attempted.name: sharpen_contrast_self_refine
selection_attempted.headline: Sharpens the chart and boosts its contrast so text labels and bar edges are crisper, then gives the model a structured second pass to look at its own answer and correct any mistakes.

selection_attempted.name: crop_upscale_multivote
selection_attempted.headline: Strips blank borders from around the chart and zooms in on just the content, then runs the model five times on the improved image and picks the most common answer.

selection_attempted.name: self_consistency_5
selection_attempted.headline: Asks the same question five times and keeps the answer the model gives most often.

selection_attempted.name: cov_equalize
selection_attempted.headline: Asks the model to answer first, then generate and answer its own fact-check questions about the chart before committing to a final answer.

selection_attempted.name: least_to_most_salient_crop
selection_attempted.headline: Zooms into the most information-dense part of the chart and walks through smaller sub-questions one at a time before producing the final answer.

selection_attempted.name: annotated_bands_vote
selection_attempted.headline: Stamps a pixel-counted band label directly onto the chart image so the model sees an objective visual measurement it cannot override, then picks the most common answer across three independent tries.
